name: std-escalating-decision
description: std-escalating-decision — the intelligence ladder itself, as one reusable composition. One request enters at DECIDE and falls through the rungs in order — R0 exact check, R1 table lookup, R3 retrieval, R4 learned inference, R5 generative classification — each rung handing off to the next by abstaining, until one proves the answer. Exits DECIDED, tagged with which rung answered (rung, confidence, matched, reasoning), or DECISION_FAILED if even the generative floor could not serve it. The escalation is a chain, not a hub: each rung listens directly to the rung above it and projects its own inputs out of the carried request, so the trait graph is a DAG and no event ever returns to a rung that already ran. Domain-agnostic: it knows about candidates and categories, not students or quizzes — grading, routing, matching, moderation, and duplicate detection are all this same molecule with different knobs. R2 (the Beta posterior) is deliberately not in this chain: it is the 'decide what to do next' half of a turn and already lives in std-knowledge-tracing.

emits.description: Starts the ladder at the exact-check rung (R0). request is the whole DECIDE payload, carried down the chain so each rung can project its own inputs.

events.name: Decide
events.description: Public entry point — decide the candidate, falling through the ladder until a rung can prove the answer. accepted is R1's table; categories is R3's comparison set (R5's closed label set is the ClassifyRung categories knob, a design-time decision rather than a per-request one).

events.name: Run Exact
events.description: Starts the ladder at the exact-check rung (R0). request is the whole DECIDE payload, carried down the chain so each rung can project its own inputs.

emits.description: Fired when the candidate exactly equals the key under the configured normalization
Abstain — candidate does not equal the key; the next rung should take over. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

events.name: Exact Matched
events.description: Fired when the candidate exactly equals the key under the configured normalization

events.name: Exact Unmatched
events.description: Abstain — candidate does not equal the key; the next rung should take over. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

numericTolerance.label: Numeric tolerance
numericTolerance.description: Absolute tolerance applied when both candidate and key are numbers; 0 requires an exact numeric match

trimWhitespace.label: Trim whitespace
trimWhitespace.description: Strip leading and trailing whitespace from both sides before comparing

caseSensitive.label: Case sensitive
caseSensitive.description: Compare candidate and key with case sensitivity; off lowercases both sides before comparing

emits.description: Fired when the candidate matches an entry in the accepted list
Abstain — candidate matches nothing in the accepted list; the next rung should take over. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

events.name: Key Hit
events.description: Fired when the candidate matches an entry in the accepted list

events.name: Key Miss
events.description: Abstain — candidate matches nothing in the accepted list; the next rung should take over. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

normalize.label: Normalize
normalize.description: Trim and lowercase both sides before comparing

matchField.label: Match field
matchField.description: When the accepted list holds objects rather than scalars, the field to compare against the candidate; empty compares each element itself

emits.description: Raw embeddings from llm/embed — query vector at index 0, candidate vectors following in input order
Candidate matched with high confidence — score at or above floor, with a clear margin over the runner-up

No confident match — reason is one of: empty candidate list, below floor, thin margin, embedding unavailable. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

events.name: Embedded
events.description: Raw embeddings from llm/embed — query vector at index 0, candidate vectors following in input order

events.name: Similarity Matched
events.description: Candidate matched with high confidence — score at or above floor, with a clear margin over the runner-up

events.name: Similarity Abstained
events.description: No confident match — reason is one of: empty candidate list, below floor, thin margin, embedding unavailable. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

margin.label: Match margin
margin.description: Minimum gap between the best and second-best score required to trust the match

embedModel.label: Embedding model
embedModel.description: Reserved for embedding-model selection; llm/embed takes only a texts array today, so this knob is not yet wired into the call

floor.label: Match floor
floor.description: Minimum cosine score for a confident match

emits.description: Raw ml.infer service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor
call-service infer failure signal — a masar cold start or a down endpoint lands here, not as a user-visible error
The service answered, the output satisfies outputContract, and confidence clears confidenceFloor — output already clamped

The abstain — reason is one of: low confidence, contract violation, unavailable. violations is populated only on the contract violation path. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

events.name: Inferred Raw
events.description: Raw ml.infer service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: Infer Call Failed
events.description: call-service infer failure signal — a masar cold start or a down endpoint lands here, not as a user-visible error

events.name: Inferred
events.description: The service answered, the output satisfies outputContract, and confidence clears confidenceFloor — output already clamped

events.name: Infer Abstained
events.description: The abstain — reason is one of: low confidence, contract violation, unavailable. violations is populated only on the contract violation path. request echoes the originating request untouched so the next rung can project its own inputs out of it

outputContract.label: Output contract
outputContract.description: Declared shape and per-dimension ranges the model output must satisfy; a failing check abstains with reason contract violation. Omit shape to assert ranges only — an empty shape [] asserts a SCALAR output, it does not mean unconstrained

model.label: Model reference
model.description: hf:<id> for off-the-shelf weights, or a masar checkpoint id, forwarded to the ml service infer action

confidenceFloor.label: Confidence floor
confidenceFloor.description: Minimum service-reported confidence required to answer; below this the atom abstains with reason low confidence

emits.description: Raw llm.classify service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor
Structured LLM verdict — closed-set category with confidence and reasoning
The classify service call failed; this rung never abstains, only answers or fails

events.name: Classified Raw
events.description: Raw llm.classify service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: Classified
events.description: Structured LLM verdict — closed-set category with confidence and reasoning

events.name: Classify Failed
events.description: The classify service call failed; this rung never abstains, only answers or fails

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Reserved for provider selection; LLMServiceActions.classify (packages/almadar-llm/src/contracts.ts) takes no provider param today, so this knob is not forwarded to the call

categories.label: Categories
categories.description: Closed set of category labels the LLM must choose from

model.label: Model
model.description: Model override forwarded to the classify call

emits.description: The ladder proved an answer. rung names which one served it: R0 exact, R1 table, R3 retrieved, R4 learned, R5 generative.
Even the generative floor (R5) could not answer — the classify service call itself failed.

events.description: The ladder proved an answer. rung names which one served it: R0 exact, R1 table, R3 retrieved, R4 learned, R5 generative.

events.name: Decision Failed
